programme.title: Pyar Ke Kabil
programme.desc: Kiran and Jyoti are twins who were separated after their parents uncoupled. Years later, they meet accidentally at a picnic and decide to exchange places in an effort to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Action Time
programme.desc: Vedha and his daughter Kanaka are on a killing spree. They are being chased by a cop Rama, but they always manage to escape in the nick of time. Can Rama stop the killings?

programme.title: Biwi.Com
programme.desc: When a pandit predicts that Kishan will marry thrice in his lifetime, his wife Shilpa forces him into a second marriage. When the wives start fighting, a third woman arrives from London for Kishan.

programme.title: Love Mocktail 2
programme.desc: With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.

programme.title: Farz
programme.desc: Gopal, a secret agent, investigates the death of his colleague who possessed evidence against a known terrorist. Gopal and Kamla embark on a journey to find the traitor.

programme.title: Mast
programme.desc: Kittu is madly in love with Malika, an actress, and travels to her house in Mumbai from Pune after his father scolds him for his decreasing exam scores.

programme.title: Ghatak
programme.desc: When Kashi visits a community with his father, he is shocked to see the torturous regime of Katya. He tries to oppose Katya, but ends up compromising the safety of his family and relatives.

programme.title: Nazar Ke Samne
programme.desc: Jai, an unemployed drunk, gives false testimony that puts an innocent man in jail for murder. However, he later relents and tries to exonerate him by searching for the real killer.

programme.title: Shehzaade
programme.desc: Suraj, a justice-loving man, must face a series of obstacles when he discovers his widowed mother's affair with a former prisoner.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Bloody Mary
programme.desc: In an attempt to fulfill their dreams, three friends get entangled in trouble related to a director's death. Meanwhile, they confront an inspector while trying to save themselves.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: Guddu Ki Gun
programme.desc: Guddu, a salesman, lands in dire trouble when his girlfriend's grandfather casts a spell on him for cheating on her. However, he must find true love to get rid of the curse.

programme.title: Pithamagan
programme.desc: An imposter befriends a social outcast convicted in a drug-peddling case in prison. However, when they are released from jail, they get entangled in a local drug lord's vicious scheme.

programme.title: Rustum
programme.desc: ACP Abhishek Bhargav is determined to find the culprits behind the death of his friend, DCP Bharath. His investigation takes him to Bangalore, where he uncovers revelations of an organ trade mafia.

programme.title: Anokhi Ada
programme.desc: Lalaji and Gupta, two business partners, take their relationship to the next level when their children, Rakesh and Neeta, marry each other. However, chaos ensues when Lalaji helps Gopal, a stranger.

programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Wafadaar
programme.desc: Chanda's parents disapprove of her boyfriend Ranga and want her to marry Prasad. Ranga is accused of having an affair with Sita. Chanda faces turmoil in her life.

The Brooklyn-Bells try to coax him back, but he refuses to return. Doug decides to make a mini swimming pool by filling the ball pit with cool water. Waffle loves swimming pools.

programme.title: Earth's Natural Wonders
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Surviving the ExtremeIn the high Himalaya, join yak-herder Thokmay Lowa and his small group as he steers his herd through one of the region's extreme mountain passes. In the Canadian Arctic, 63-year-old Minnie Nappaaluk and her granddaughter Eva embark on one of the most hazardous expeditions for food: the mussel harvest. In the blistering Australian outback, the only way to efficiently round up cattle herds on vast farms is through the use of helicopter cowboys like Chris Weyand.

programme.title: The Story of Scottish Art

programme.title: Beverly Hills Chihuahua
programme.desc: A pampered pet dog gets separated from her owner, and is left stranded in Mexico struggling to avoid a dognapper and a ferocious Doberman, who are after her diamond collar. Luckily, a courageous German shepherd is on hand to help her get back home. Comedy, starring Piper Perabo and Jamie Lee Curtis, with the voices of Drew Barrymore and Andy Garcia.

programme.title: Brave
programme.desc: A princess defies her mother's plans to secure peace by marrying her off to the son of one of their allies. A witch provides the rebellious royal with a magic spell to change her fate, but the enchantment backfires disastrously when the queen is transformed into a bear. Pixar's animated fantasy, with the voices of Kelly Macdonald, Emma Thompson and Billy Connolly.

programme.title: Percy Jackson & the Lightning Thief
programme.desc: A teenager is shocked to discover he is the son of Greek god Poseidon and has been accused of stealing Zeus's lightning bolt. The youngster is given 14 days to find the culprit and return the missing item before the furious deity instigates an apocalyptic war. Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: Lilo & Stitch
programme.desc: A lonely little girl befriends a runaway alien that helps mend her fractured family. Live action fantasy adventure, starring Maia Kealoha and Sydney Agudong.

programme.title: Beauty and the Beast
programme.desc: A prince is transformed into a hideous monster as punishment for his selfishness, and can only regain his human form by finding true love. Salvation comes in the form of a spirited village girl, who offers to take her father's place when he is imprisoned in the monster's castle. But as romance blossoms between the unlikely pair, a jealous rival suitor only sees a beast to be slain. Live-action remake of the Disney animated fairy tale, starring Emma Watson, Dan Stevens and Luke Evans, with Ewan McGregor, Emma Thompson and Ian McKellen playing the Beast's entourage of living ornaments.

programme.title: Ralph Breaks the Internet
programme.desc: Six years after the events of Wreck-It Ralph, the destructive video game character and his hyperactive friend Vanellope discover a wi-fi router in Litwak's Family Fun Centre and Arcade. Before long, they embark on a new quest involving Disney princesses, and a few familar faces. Animated adventure, with the voices of John C Reilly, Sarah Silverman and Gal Gadot.

programme.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
programme.desc: A boy abducted by aliens grows up to be an interstellar mercenary. He and a band of misfits break out of a prison space station with a plan to sell a mysterious orb to the highest bidder - but cross a warlord, who intends to turn it into a powerful weapon. Sci-fi adventure, starring Chris Pratt, Zoe Saldana and Dave Bautista, with the voices of Bradley Cooper and Vin Diesel.

programme.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
programme.desc: Amid emerging demand for hyperfuel and other resources, a headstrong pilot gets mixed up with a bunch of mercenaries, a militant robot, a gambler and a Wookie while attempting to appease a crime lord in an adventure that exposes an underworld's seedy belly. Sci-fi prequel set before the events of Star Wars: A New Hope, starring Alden Ehrenreich, Emilia Clarke, Woody Harrelson, Donald Glover and Paul Bettany.

programme.title: Tron: Legacy
programme.desc: Ground-breaking computer genius Kevin Flynn disappears without trace. Years later, his son Sam goes looking for him, and is transported into a computer-generated world where he is forced to compete in deadly gladiatorial combat by an evil duplicate of his father plotting to wage war on the real world. programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: S9 E36In a rugby-themed show, James cooks for former England player Maggie Alphonsi and ITV Sport's chief presenter Mark Pougatch. Chef Doug Crampton and baker Richard Bertinet are also in the kitchen and gardening expert David Domeney talks growing and nurturing apples.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Quick and Fabulous SuppersClodagh McKenna demonstrates four of her favourite recipes for quick and fabulous suppers, including a chicken curry, and creamy Gruyère baked eggs. She then takes an emotional trip down memory lane to share a speedy pancetta and garlic mussels dish inspired by her dad, before whipping up a pan of cheesy lemony ate-night Alfredo pasta.

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: E84 — 21/11/2026 - 1Round-up of the latest headlines.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: England v New ZealandEngland v New Zealand (Kick-off 2.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' final match of the round-robin stage, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England produced an excellent display when these teams last met a year ago, claiming a 33 - 19 victory to end a run of three straight defeats at the hands of the All Blacks. With analysis from Ugo Monye, Sean Fitzpatrick and Danny Care, pitchside reports from Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay.

programme.title: Nations Championship
programme.desc: Ireland v South AfricaIreland v South Africa (Kick-off 4.40pm). All the action from the match at Aviva Stadium, as both teams conclude their round-robin fixtures. These nations last faced each other 12 months ago, when the world champions claimed a 24-13 victory in a chaotic encounter that saw Ireland receive five cards, even playing with 12 men at the end of the first half, and the Springboks also get reduced to 14 men in the second half. With analysis from Bryan Habana and David Flatman, pitchside inserts by Claire Thomas and Brian O'Driscoll, and commentary from Miles Harrison and Gordon D'Arcy.

programme.desc: S11 E6Stephen Mulhern hosts another charity edition of the game show, with Stephen Mangan, Kemi Rodgers and Tom Allen all trying to say what they see, as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes.

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: S4 E5Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000.

programme.title: Grantchester
programme.desc: S9 E3Following the departure of Will Davenport, Grantchester has a new vicar in the form of Alphy Kottaram but Geordie manages to get off on the wrong foot with him. The pair soon find themselves teaming up to investigate the murder of a local landowner.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: S5 E7The Fletchers are back at the Royal Cheshire Show, but this year they're swapping the show ring for trading. For Marnie and her lamb, Hope, it's an emotional journey towards their debut in the Young Handlers class. First-time nerves are running high, but preparations take a worrying turn when Kelvin spots maggots in Hope's fleece.

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Blair CastleThe chef's culinary tour of Britain continues in Scotland with a trip to Blair Castle in the Highlands, where he takes a tour of the grounds and cooks venison with beetroot and blackberries in the castle's walled garden. Later, James gets a masterclass in Highland gaming as two young brothers David and Harry share the secrets to the famous caber toss.

programme.title: EFL Live

Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. programme.title: EFL Live
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Burnley v Blackburn RoversBurnley v Blackburn Rovers (Kick-off 12.00pm). Hugh Woozencroft presents coverage of the Championship match from Turf Moor, as the rivals face each other in the East Lancashire derby. There have been 170 previous meetings between these teams in all competitions, dating back to the 1888/89 season, and it is the Clarets who narrowly hold the better record with 71 wins to Rovers 65, with the other 34 games ending in draws. The most recent meeting was in the 2024/25 campaign and saw Burnley triumph 1-0 at Ewood Park, with the corresponding clash here ending in a 1-1 stalemate. With analysis from Ben Mee and Brad Friedel, commentary by Seb Hutchinson and Lucy Ward, and reports from Katie Shanahan.

Eager for revenge, and with a traitor on the loose, Bond sets off on his own mission - to get close to evil megalomaniac Gustav Graves and uncover the secrets of his Icarus Project.

programme.title: Confessions from a Holiday Camp
programme.desc: 1977. Comedy. Directed by Norman Cohen. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith And Bill Maynard. Holiday camp employees enjoy their summer celebrations until a new manager arrives to spoil the fun.

programme.title: EuroTrash
programme.desc: 1998. Hosted by Antoine de Caunes. We meet a Spanish siren with castanets, meet Finland's biggest slappers, Lolo dives deep down with her snorkel and one man goes down in medical history.

programme.title: Yanky Panky
programme.desc: 2000. Join country music persona Tina C as she uncovers the eccentric subcultures, bizarre personalities, and the rude, crude and lewd underbelly of American society.

programme.title: The Hitch-Hiker
programme.desc: 1953. Thriller. Director Ida Lupino. Stars Edmond O'Brien, Frank Lovejoy And William Talman. Ray And Gilbert's fishing trip takes a turn when they pick up a hitch-hiker who turns out to be on the run. [S]

programme.title: The Day Time Ended
programme.desc: 1979. Sci-Fi. Director: John Cardos. Stars Jim Davis, Christopher Mitchum And Dorothy Malone. Aliens visit the house of a family. The house is sucked into a time warp that sends it back in time. [S]

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: Who Are You? 1960. Stars Philip Bourneuf And Anna Lee. After a young girl recovers from scarlet fever, she rejects her parents and insists she is the recently deceased daughter of another family. [S]

programme.title: Down Among The Z Men
programme.desc: 1952. Comedy directed by Maclean Rogers and starring Michael Bentine, Harry Secombe, Spike Milligan and Peter Sellers. Prof. Pureheart loses a secret formula in the grocery shop. [S]

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1959. The Unseeing Eye. Directed by Geoffrey Muller. Starring Russell Napier, John Stone and Denny Dayviss. A night worker returning home sees smoke and flames coming from a building. (S1, E30)

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: The Case of the Split Ticket. 1954. Starring: Ronald Howard, Howard Marion-Crawford And Archie Duncan. When O'Casey wins the lottery, they must find Albert before the ticket runs out. [S]

programme.title: The Brave Don't Cry
programme.desc: 1952. Drama. Directed by Philip Leacock. Starring John Gregson, Meg Buchanan And John Rae. Based on a true story. In a small Scots mining-town, a mine cave-in seals the entire crew. [S]

programme.title: X The Unknown
programme.desc: 1956. Fantasy. Directed by Leslie Norman. Stars Dean Jagger, Edward Chapman And Leo McKern. A radioactive creature terrorises a remote Scottish village, will anyone be able to stop it? [S]

programme.title: North West Frontier
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Director: J. Lee Thompson. Stars Kenneth More, Lauren Bacall And Herbert Lom. In British India, a prince must be taken to safety across a rebel-held territory. [S]

programme.title: Water World
programme.desc: 2000. Actor and canal enthusiast Timothy West narrates the story of the incredible engineering feats needed to build canals and meets some of the characters to be found on inland waterways today. [S]

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: Surprise, Surprise. 1985. Stars Mollie Sugden, Deddie Davies And Eric Francis. Ida drops hints about what she wants for her upcoming birthday, but when it arrives she ends up disappointed. [S]

programme.title: For the Love of Ada
programme.desc: Birth. Stars: Wilfred Pickles, Irene Handl And Jack Smethurst. Ada is about to become a grandmother but when Ruth's baby arrives, Leslie is at first nowhere to be found. (S4, E03) [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Waverly Ring Affair. 1966. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum And Larry Blyden. THRUSH has a mole inside New York headquarters. Solo and Kuryakin are assigned to root out the double agent. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: This week's first stop is Piccadilly Roundabout in 1944 wartime London, there's a slice of history from a bread factory in 1966, a reel of 1950s Italy and a look at the history of Baxter's. [S]

programme.title: Enemy At The Door
programme.desc: Pains And Penalties. 1978. Stars: Alfred Burke, Bernard Horsfall. Dr. Martel arranges hospitalisation for frail old Mrs. Bree who, with her son Edward, are rent-free tenants of Peter. [S]

programme.title: Jigsaw
programme.desc: 1962. Directed by Val Guest and starring Jack Warner. A woman is murdered and it's up to Detective Fellows to sift through the clues and solve the 'Jigsaw'. Great shots of Brighton in the 60s. [S]

programme.title: Fox
programme.desc: Just An Iron Monkey. 1980. Stars Bernard Hill, Mary Peach And Lee Walker. Vin tries to sort out his finances so he can buy a country pub. Ray is also offered a good business proposition. [S]

programme.title: An Innocent Man
programme.desc: 1989. Crime Drama. Directed by Peter Yates. Stars Tom Selleck, F. Murray Abraham And Laila Robins. Two corrupt cops send an innocent man to prison, leading him to seek revenge on his release. [S]

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: Play of the Month: Robinson Crusoe
programme.desc: 1974. Drama. Director: James MacTaggart. Stars Stanley Baker, Ram John Holder And Jerome Willis. A man struggles to survive after being shipwrecked on a deserted island. [S]

programme.title: Three Silent Men
programme.desc: 1940. Crime. An inventor of a deadly weapon to be used against the allies is injured in a crash. Surgeon, Sir James (Sebastian Shaw) saves his life but learns of his plot. Stars Derrick De Marney. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: The Hero. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Bill Owen And John Dearth. After the sheriff's brother is killed, the man responsible is taken in by Robin, but tensions soon rise as he struggles to fit in. [S]

programme.title: Supercar
programme.desc: The Lost City. 1961. Stars David Graham, George Murcell And Graydon Gould. On the way to the South Pole, an uncontrolled force lands them on a strange island where they are in danger. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: The Rattan Trunk. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Peter Grant And Jan Holden. Bert Edwards receives a trunk full of Persian rugs. Soon after the luggage turns up at Euston Station with a body inside. [S]

programme.title: The Detectives
programme.desc: Conspiracy Of Silence. Captain Matt Holbrook (Robert Taylor) leads a squad of brave and tough detectives tackling crime. Also Stars: Tige Andrews, Russell Thorson, Adam West. [S]

programme.title: The Great Van Robbery

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E4We examine the robot that defused bombs both on foreign battlefields and British streets, and an astonishing Gulf War minelayer.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E1Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Bomb
programme.desc: E2Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E3Focusing on the fanatical women who took Hitler under their wing and, through love and devotion, acclimatised him to high society to launch him to power, only to be left behind once he achieved it.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E4Cataloguing the many lovers of the Nazi dictator, and charting the unfortunate demise of all who dared resist his love, affection and sexual appetite.

programme.title: D Day: 100 Days To Beat The Third Reich
programme.desc: E1This documentary will bring back to life the 100 days it took for the Allies to liberate Normandy, to break through the German line and to pave the way towards victory. 100 critical days, both heroic and tragic, that made history.

programme.title: D Day: 100 Days To Beat The Third Reich
programme.desc: E2This documentary will bring back to life the 100 days it took for the Allies to liberate Normandy, to break through the German line and to pave the way towards victory. 100 critical days, both heroic and tragic, that made history.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E1A look at the women surrounding Hitler once he came to power, and how they were held up as the Aryan Ideal to strive for once the Nazi dictator approved of their positions.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E2How women were active - and often violent participants and perpetrators - in the conflict and its attendant atrocities - especially the Holocaust.

programme.title: Hitler's Handmaidens
programme.desc: E3Focusing on the fanatical women who took Hitler under their wing and, through love and devotion, acclimatised him to high society to launch him to power, only to be left behind once he achieved it.

programme.desc: E4Cataloguing the many lovers of the Nazi dictator, and charting the unfortunate demise of all who dared resist his love, affection and sexual appetite.

programme.desc: E2Did Nazi uranium make it to Japan in the final months of WW2? Were the Axis powers closer to a bomb than we think? Drama unfolds as experts shed new light on the hardships, challenges and secrets of a war-torn, pre-nuclear world.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The Grumman Avenger, which was the most important carrier-based torpedo bomber on American and British carriers throughout the Second World War. They were also the biggest and heaviest carrier aircraft of the conflict.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The Junkers Ju 52, which is considered one of the most famous airplanes in history. It was first designed as an airliner, but was used as a transport, bomber, and air ambulance during the Second World War.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7True predators of the skies, the F-16 and the MiG-29 were created to fight each other, based on radically different design philosophies.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E5John F Kennedy first made news in 1943 when, as a skipper of a torpedo boat in the Pacific, he and his crew were shipwrecked. We tell the story of their rescue.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E6We explore two submarines – former Cold War enemies now moored in a Kent river, and discover the story of Vasili Arkhipov, a Soviet submariner who refused to authorise a nuclear launch.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E5Vera finds out her agents' fate. Her beliefs about Noor are challenged. Suspicions lead Vera to hunt down a Nazi mastermind.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E6Capture of a key Nazi uncovers shocking realities. Amid demands for accountability, as Vera and her team navigate murky waters to confront uncomfortable truths.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E3Ordinary objects can become extraordinary when pulled from the battlefield. In this episode, Jason and Bruce explore a regimental band cornet, owned by a band member who tragically died during the infamous Battle of Isandlwana.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E4Escape and survival in war often came down to ingenuity and courage. Jason and Bruce showcase miniature escape compasses, cunningly disguised inside RAF tunic buttons and belt buckles to help downed airmen find their way home.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E2Exploring how the seeds of Japan's defeat in 1945 were sown a decade earlier with the occupation of Manchuria in China.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Heinkel He 111 is one of the most recognised German aircraft of WW2. The broad winged design was a guinea pig for future bombers, with more variants than any other military aircraft of the time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6We trace the astonishing story of designers turning away from metal and back to wood to create a twin-engine bomber that could outrun almost any aircraft in the sky, yet deliver a bomb load greater than an Avro Lancaster.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.
